column1: # Path glob -> work package. Read by tools/owners-check.
# First matching row wins, so specific rows sit above broader ones.
# Globs: * = any characters except /, ** = any characters, {a,b} = either.
# GEN paths (written only by tools/build, tools/assemble, tools/fixtures-gen,
# tools/canary-baseline, tools/helper-replies-gen) belong to build: the
# integrator commits them on main, never a WP branch.
# The launcher leaves plugin/bin/ in the launcher move; this row stays
# until that move has removed the old folder, so the removal itself is owned.
# The opt-in restart launcher and its shell cases.
# The lib and case rows below restate
# the broader rows on purpose, so each new path shows its owner: wait, jobs,
# 0.1.6 queue contract: `queue check` runs the read-only part of the queue_cmd contract (assets/queue-contract.md).
# 0.1.7: `cache`, the status line's read-only cache state (lib/cachestate.pm, assets/cache-contract.md).
# 0.1.8: `usage`, the shared usage record the mod reads and writes (lib/usagerec.pm).
# The local shadow trial: two read/save commands beside lib/trial.pm.
# Restart on update: the helper's restart command.
# 0.1.2 visible defaults and the settings writer: settings show, set and reset (lib/settings_write.pm, lib/settings_reset.pm).
# 0.1.6 PRUNE: the user-run prune of old evidence (lib/skills/prune.pm), beside verify.
# The home guard (0.1.2): the one child-environment guard of the core case runner and the watch driver.
# The docs sources (tools/build renders README.md, docs/ and plugin/README.md from them).
